title: Should the rock and the fox sprites be redrawn with fewer colours?
question:
Some shipped sprites still carry speckle left over from the art generator: dozens of near-identical colours, many used by a single pixel, where a hand-drawn sprite would use a handful. The art pipeline now removes this automatically from every new sprite (it snaps each pixel to one of a few colours already in the sprite, never an invented average). Two sprites that already ship still show it: the rock obstacle, with 55 colours of which 30 are single pixels, and the fox, with 24 colours of which 7 are single pixels. The attached boards show each one as shipped beside the cleaned-up version at three sizes of palette. Should the shipped files be replaced?

Saying yes replaces those two image files in the game with the cleaned-up version at the size named in the option; nothing else changes, and the original files remain available in the project's change history. The songbird and rabbit that prompted this work were already cleaned up on 7 September and are not part of the question.
why_now: The cleanup step landed today (commit 4beb63b) together with a count of colours on all 53 shipped sprite sheets. Only these two show the leftover speckle. The spiral tower has more colours (52) but only 2 single-pixel ones, which reads as real detail rather than speckle, so it is left alone.

options.label: Replace both: the rock at 10 colours, the fox at 8 (Recommended)
options.detail: Both keep every shape and highlight in the boards, and the rock loses its visible grain. This clears the last two sprites with the defect.

options.label: Replace only the rock at 10 colours
options.detail: The rock is the extreme case (more than half its colours are single pixels). The fox keeps its current shading, which is closer to what was generated.

options.label: Keep both as shipped
options.detail: The cleanup applies only to sprites generated from now on. The rock and fox keep their speckle.

links.caption: The rock obstacle at 3 sizes each: as shipped (55 colours), then cleaned to 16, 10 and 6 colours. Rendered from the shipped file by tools/compose_palette_quantize_candidates.py.
The fox: as shipped (24 colours), then cleaned to 10, 8 and 5 colours. Same tool, same shipped file.

subject: Sprite colour speckle

ruled.summary: Ruled 2026-09-25: (b) replace only the rock at 10 colours, with Daniel's note that the fox must be redrawn. Both done in 5bd04fc (S-27).
